explanation: ARP stands for Address Resolution Protocol.

text: ARP operates at which OSI layer?
explanation: ARP operates at Layer 2 (Data Link layer) to resolve Layer 3 IP addresses to Layer 2 MAC addresses.

text: The destination MAC of an ARP request is a broadcast.
explanation: ARP requests use the broadcast MAC FF:FF:FF:FF:FF:FF to reach all devices on the local network.

text: What command can show the ARP table on a Cisco device?
explanation: The 'show ip arp' command displays the ARP cache on Cisco IOS devices.

text: ARP resolves IP addresses to MAC addresses.
explanation: The primary function of ARP is to map known IP addresses to unknown MAC addresses on a local network.
